title: Enable GitHub Pages, run the deploy and observe the live HTTPS URL

blockers.capability: Enable Pages with source = GitHub Actions
blockers.missing: A GitHub token with the fine-grained repository permission "Pages": write (classic PAT equivalent: "repo" scope), held by a principal with admin access to rikterbeek/melvo-app. No token of any kind is present in this environment.
blockers.evidence: node tools/verification/probe-deploy-capability.js → FAIL token:pages-administration-write — no token in any of GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_PAT, PAGES_ADMIN_TOKEN, MELVO_GITHUB_TOKEN (docs/verification/capability-probe.log)

blockers.capability: Dispatch the deploy workflow on the default branch and read its run
blockers.missing: A GitHub token with the fine-grained repository permission "Actions": write (dispatch) and read (run status). Not present.
blockers.evidence: Same probe run; no token present. gh CLI is also absent: FAIL cli:gh — gh is not installed (docs/verification/capability-probe.log)

blockers.capability: Observe the host-assigned HTTPS URL rather than derive it
blockers.api: GET /repos/rikterbeek/melvo-app/pages → .html_url (or the deploy run's page_url output)
blockers.missing: Outbound network access with DNS resolution for api.github.com. DNS resolution fails in this environment, so the host cannot be asked what URL it assigned.
blockers.evidence: FAIL dns:api.github.com — api.github.com did not resolve: EAI_AGAIN; FAIL https:api.github.com — getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN (docs/verification/capability-probe.log)

blockers.capability: Capture GET / headers, the HTTP→HTTPS redirect and the certificate (SEC-1)
blockers.missing: Outbound HTTPS (443) and HTTP (80) egress to the Pages host, plus the observed URL from the blocker above. Neither is available.
blockers.evidence: No egress: all network probes failed with EAI_AGAIN (docs/verification/capability-probe.log)

notDone: No URL is recorded. The repository remote is https://github.com/rikterbeek/melvo-app, from which a Pages URL could be guessed, but a guessed URL is not an observation and this task explicitly forbids recording one.

readyToDeploy.verifiedBy: npm test — the document, the single workflow and the single publish directory are asserted locally
